purpose: Audit an existing synthetic capacity claim, including its decoder cost; no production promotion from this screen
controls: Identical labels, signal dimension, number of facts and alphabet. Each encoder uses existing Gaussian builder and existing block AMP. Sharded means width 1 with 32 independent blocks. All allocated matrices and decoder metadata count. Noise vector is shared within a seed and scaled to each signal standard deviation.
exclusions: No official data, retrieval quality inference, dropout experiment, tuning, new capacity theorem, or production backend. This is three synthetic seeds, not a deployment evaluation. Existing dropout helper changes d without renormalizing its retained design matrix and is not used here.
interpretation: Compare all methods on both accuracy and allocated design bytes. Signal-only storage is not total memory. Count nonzero matrix payload separately as a possible structured-storage optimization, not measured resident memory. Report exact label bit payload as a task-scope reference, not a soft-readout competitor. Latencies are exploratory under concurrent work.
